digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure — CI workflow parity collection subprocess
propositions: _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest collection without --basetemp, allowing its session cleanup to delete or traverse shared numbered temp root entries from parallel runs
nested pytest collection subprocess initialized against shared numbered root can corrupt or stall on preexisting temp trees from concurrent test sessions
_collect_node_ids must pass a caller-owned private --basetemp to nested pytest while preserving collection selection, stdout parsing, return code contract, and 300s timeout
held-out regression test proves sentinel entries in poisoned shared numbered-root are deleted by unpatched _collect_node_ids and preserved by patched version with private basetemp
_store_isolation pattern exists but does not cover _collect_node_ids independent caller, creating duplicate hazard
